method: Per-process WDDM GPU counters summed only for browser descendants of the benchmark process, plus adapter-level DedicatedUsage (peak across adapter instances) and nvidia-smi memory.used. The adapter delta is an upper bound that includes every process on the adapter, not app-only texture bytes. Per-process sums are unreliable when they exceed the adapter total; that condition is reported as perProcessReliable: false.
